text: Glitterspud Purans are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Brad Flatforms in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Golden Mascaras are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Aquaneze Cosmetics in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Gorgeous Blushers are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Aquaneze Cosmetics in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Gladiator Wrestling are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Hobby Knick-Knacks in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of KOS-MOS.
Gormotti Woodwings are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Fallone Crafts in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Girdys is an NPC in . Girdys is an Urayan who can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Fonsa Myma. Girdys runs a shop called Maluria Antiques specialized in Art.
Glitterbakes are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be created by Pyra at the kitchens in Tora's House and Corinne's House.

Goliath Brogs (Japanese: , Goraiasu Guroggu) are enemies in . They are members of the Brog family and can be found at level 42-44 on the Upper Level - Right area of the Gormott Province, particularly at Coolley Lake.
Gorian Buloofos (Japanese: , Gorian Urusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Buloofo family and can be found at level 8 - 10 near Lyta Oasis and the Waytree in the Gormott Province.

Giga Rosa (Japanese: , G Sakura) is a Boss in . She is an Artificial Blade fought at level 42 in the Hangar of the Ardainian Battleship while it is moored in the Indoline Praetorium. She is an upgraded version of Rosa, and is piloted by Bana.
The Gormott Province Collection lists all the Collectibles found in the Gormott Province in .

Glaw Garaffas (Japanese: , Gurou Girafe) are enemies in . They are members of the Garaffa family and can be found at level 5-11 on the Lower Level or the Upper Level - Right area of Gormott Province, particularly at Lyta Oasis.
Giant Stag Beetles are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Gormott Province. In the , Giant Stag Beetles can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Grad Gogols (Japanese: , Gurāto Gogōru) are enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family and can be found at level 41-44 on either side of the Great Pillar Passage in the Kingdom of Tantal. They appear anytime except during Cloud Sea Mist condition while in this instance, they are replaced by Redom Crustips. Two of them must be defeated to unlock Corvin's Level 4 Fuga Daemonum, and four of them to unlock Dromarch's Level 4 Wild Roar.

Glarna Stir-Fries are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Speck Butchers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. They can also be purchased for 1,200 G from the Pouch Item Emporium in the Land of Challenge after collecting the Nopon Invitation, Pt. 2 on Version 1.5.2 or later. During New Game Plus, eight of them are needed to unlock Cressidus's level 5 "Earth Breath" affinity reward.
Giant's Black Rings are Treasure items in . They can be found in the Argentum Trade Guild by Salvaging at any Argentum Salvage Point.
Giron Volffs (Japanese: , Giron Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family, and can be found at level 33-41 at Battlescar Cove in the Peninsula of Temperantia.
Ghudan Laias (Japanese: , Gyudan Raia) are enemies in . They are members of the Laia family, and can be found at level 35-37 at Overlook Hill on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Glox Krabbles (Japanese: , Gyokusu Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 42-46 at Triedge Isle on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Graaz Pippitos (Japanese: , Gurasse Pipitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family, and can be found at level 40 - 42 at the Amphoret Pillar on the Upper Level, and the Pippito's Haunt on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. One Graaz Pippito is involved during the quest The Lost Turtle.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Goddess Chokers (Japanese: , Megami no Chōkā) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's Luck stat by up to 27%. They are the upgraded version of the Nacre Choker accessory. The Comet Choker and Sunlight Choker accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Bunnit Choker and Gold Gear Choker accessories. Outside of combat, they slightly improve the odds of bonding with Rare Blades during Blade Resonance.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Gold Gear Chokers (Japanese: , Gōrudo Gia Chōkā) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's Luck stat by up to 27. They are the upgraded version of the Bunnit Choker accessory. For a similar multiplicative effect that can stack with this gear, check the Nacre Choker, Goddess Choker, Comet Choker and Sunlight Choker accessories. Other sources of Luck apply before this fixed stat bonus. Outside of combat, they slightly improve the odds of bonding with Rare Blades during Blade Resonance.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Gold Nopon Masks (Japanese: , Gōrudo Nopon no Kamen) are accessories in and . They increase the Aggro of the wearer passively by a large amount every second. They are the upgraded version of the Nopon Mask and Metal Nopon Mask. The DLC exclusive Platinum Nopon Mask accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.
Gliding Swallow (Japanese: , Hien) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Bitball. In the , it is also one of Mòrag's arts when using Bunnie.
Giant Pine Cones are Tree collectibles in . They can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha. In the , Giant Pine Cones can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Gloomy Pitcher Plants are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Land of Morytha, in particular from the Collection Point located at the far end of Highway 8 or the one located southeast of the "Blocked Road" map marker, from the nearest Skip Travel point Fallen Skyscraper. Using certain Blades' Botany field skill increases chances.

Glory Anglers are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia, in particular at the closest Collection Point to the east of Triedge Isle and the Collection Point at the shore of Blackday Peninsula. Four must be collected to unlock Elma's level 3 "Lockpicking" Field Skill.

Glutinous Sands are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular northwest of Midorl Bridge. They can also be found in the Indoline Praetorium, in the tunnel north of the Fount of Holy Light.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Goddess Banners (Japanese: , Ikusamegami no Danki) are accessories in and . They increase damage dealt against launched enemies by up to 85%. They are the upgraded version of the Swordfighting Banner accessory. The Ancient Banner and War God Banner accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

Golden Cylinders are cylinders in . They can be initially bought from Larmogg Salvaging in Alba Cavanich, and become available in all other Cylinder Shops once Chapter 4 is completed. They prevent brown Treasure Troves from being found during Salvaging, making it easier to obtain the rarer items found in red and white troves. They increase the appearance rate of troves and decrease the appearance rate of enemies to a far greater extent than the Silver Cylinder.

Go for it, Electra! (Japanese: , Raiko Ganbarimasu!) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Electra at Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province. This quest is required to advance Electra's "Mastery of Thunder" Field Skill.
Gormotti-Ear Headbands are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Dalnes Stone in Temperantia.
Gleambugs are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Goldol Anloods (Japanese: , Gorudoru Haindo) are enemies in . They are members of the Anlood family, and can be found at level 44-50 at the Chehn Slope on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Wulfric's level 5 "Earth Mastery" and Nim's level 3 "Earth Mastery" Field Skill.

The Goldmouth Rooftop (Japanese: , Gorutomunto Okujō) is a location in . It is located in Goldmouth of the Argentum Trade Guild. The Noponya Shrine can be accessed from here by using the Ancient Nopon Key obtained during the quest The Nopon Murals. There are no enemies here.

Gold Chips are Core Chips in and . All weapons forged with a Gold Chip increase enemy drop rate by 50%. This effect remains active even if the equipped Blade is not used in battle. They can only be acquired from high level enemy drops. In , only two chips can be obtained per playthrough, from a Treasure Trove in the Kingdom of Torna. Gold Chips share their appearance with Cobalt Chips, Iron Chips and Steel Chips. __TOC__

Glass Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be obtained from enemies in the Leftherian Archipelago and the Empire of Mor Ardain as well as one Treasure Trove in the Gormott Province. In they can be dropped by Klaret Wisps. Glass Chips share their appearance with Flower Chips, Forest Chips, and Wood Chips. __TOC__

Glorious Totems (Japanese: , Guroriasu Pōru) are enemies in . They are members of the Totem family, and can be found at level 32-34 at the Daram Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago. They can also be fought at level 90 during the Challenge Battle, Humanoid Alliance. Four of them must be defeated in order to unlock Obrona's level 2 "Electric Mastery".

The Gluttonous Marrin (Japanese: , Ōgurai no Mārin) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 39 at the Salvage Point near Chansagh Wastes in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It will only appear when salvaging if the Greedy Monster info has been obtained, and only if it has not yet been killed. It drops the Lucky Core Crystal needed to awake Kasandra, having eaten her previous Driver, the Nopon Noporikh. Although defeating Gluttonous Marrin is not an explicit objective from any quest, it is considered as a quest-exclusive enemy with the dedicated blue "!" icon.
Girogi is an NPC in . Girogi is a Nopon who can be found at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. He runs a shop called Briarley Trading.
Gox is an NPC in . He is a Phonex who can be found at Ysheva Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Gormotti Fugitive is a Merc Mission in . It is received in the Kingdom of Uraya during the quest Marvelous Mercenaries. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fortitude", "Leaping" and "Dark Mastery" Field Skills.

The Golden Sunstone is a Key Item in . It must be obtained for the quest Salvage King. It is said to have once been located on the Cliffs of Morytha, from which it later fell. It can be found in a small room inside the Fallen Skyscraper in the Land of Morytha. The room is located at the top of the broken elevator shaft inside the Fallen Skyscraper, where there is a climbable grate. At the top of the climbable grate, a second grate, located behind the first, can be reached by jumping to it, and the Golden Sunstone is located in the room at the top of the grate.

The Gluttonous Pterix (Japanese: , Hōshoku no Puterusu) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Pterix family, and can be found at level 56 on a building overlooking Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the quest The Ties That Bind.
Glyn is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti who can be found at the Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province during Fresh and Fruity.

The Gong Crystal is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having her appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point west of the Ardainian Garrison in Temperantia.
Gillick (Japanese: , Girōku) is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Gormotti Walnuts are Key Items in . They are obtained from Mokumoku at the Nopon Camp in the Gormott Province by trading one Muscle Branch for each. Three are needed during Concerned Carpenter.
The Gormotti Firewood is a Key Item in . It is obtained at the Saets Lumber Co. in the Gormott Province during Tranquility, during which it must be brought to Vess.

Gloomwood Roots are Key Items in . Three are scattered around the Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys. They are required for the quest A Secret Cure. All of the Gloomwood Roots require a different proportion of the Field Skills to complete: # Requires Level 4 Fortitude and Level 7 Botany. # Requires Level 3 Fortitude and Level 10 Botany. # Requires Level 4 Fortitude and Level 9 Botany.

The Glitterspud Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Fad Foods. It enables the purchase of Glitterspud Puran from the Brad Flatforms shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Glarna Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Ship Lane Lighting. It enables the purchase of Glarna Stir-Fry from the Speck Butchers shop at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Giant Crab Attack is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Hamlish at the Mercenary HQ, after Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 5. The time required to complete this mission is 60 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Electric Mastery" and "Expeditionist" Field Skills.

This page lists all the Merc Missions available in the Gormott Province. The list may be viewed in the order they appear in the Merc Group Log. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-| Mission Log = Mission Log |-| Requirements and Rewards = Requirements and Rewards * Base reward values for Gold and Experience are increased with higher Merc Levels.
Good Habits is a Heart-to-Heart in . It takes place after taking a rest at the Lemour Inn in the Argentum Trade Guild. The conversation is about keeping a diary.

Giant Straight (Japanese: , Masshibusutorēto, Lit. "Massive Straight") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Mach Straight Punch.
Gotta Start Somewhere! is a quest in . It can be received from Ragi at the Farlaine Central Pools in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya.
Glory from the Past is a quest in . It can be received at the Little Banerro Ruins by examining the dead body in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Gianluca is an NPC in . He is an elderly Indoline sculptor who can first be found in the Indoline Praetorium. Later, after the death of Indol, he moves to Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is a sculptor and the owner of the Indoline statue accidentally taken by Boreas during Hero of the Nopon.

The Glowing Tablet is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from a Treasure Trove in Temperantia during the quest Limits of Awareness, and must be unlocked with the Morythan Tablet 1, Morythan Tablet 2, and Morythan Tablet 3 Key Items.
The Gormott Salvage Points are places in the Gormott Province in where salvaging can be performed. There are ten Salvage Points in Gormott.

Gostell Buloofos (Japanese: , Gosuteru Urusu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Buloofo family, and can be found at level 30 during the Grazing Flock Challenge Battle. They can summon Covn Pippitos when using their art "Beast Howl". This enemy drops no items.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Goliath Rings (Japanese: , Jaianto Ringu) are DLC accessories in . They extend the duration of the Launch reaction by up to 32% (1.6 seconds). This effect will only apply when the wearer inflicts the reaction. They are the upgraded version of the Soldier Ring, Berserk Ring and Tyrant Ring accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Glamorous Swimsuits (Japanese: , Keikoku no Mizugi) are DLC accessories in . They increase damage dealt while the Driver has a male Blade engaged by up to 85%. They are the upgraded version of the Charming Swimsuit accessory. The Glamorous Swimsuit can only be equipped exclusively by female Drivers (Nia and Mòrag). The male equivalent is the Enlightened Loincloth. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. They can only be equipped by female party members.

The Goliath Sauros (Japanese: , Goraiasu Saurā) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a member of the Sauros family, and can be found at level 110 during Wave 1 of the Challenge Battle Dino Drama. This enemy drops no items.

Gigante Pterix (Japanese: , Giganto Puterusu) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Pterix family, and can be found at level 100 during the fourth wave of the Challenge Battle Dino Drama. This enemy drops no items.

The Glaring Aspar (Japanese: , Nirami no Angu) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Aspar family, and can be found at level 92 in the Geothermal Mining Plant of the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC quest Search for Tekuteku.

The Gigalid Igna (Japanese: , Gīguraido Igūna) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Igna family and a Driver enemy riding a Rhinon, and can be found at level 66 in the Lud Cloudway: Fonsett of the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark, alongside the Scram, Trauv and Riot Ignas. This enemy drops no items.
Gloomwheel (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when wielding Dual Swords.

Gideon is an NPC in . He is a Tornan inventor who can be found at the Formide Shopping Ward in Auresco of the Kingdom of Torna. He takes an interest in Marcus, a young boy who is also into tinkering, and becomes his tutor. Gedd is his son.

The Golden Twin Mesa (Japanese: , Ōgon no Futago Daichi) is a location in . It is comprised of two mesas on the eastern side of the Dannagh Region in the Kingdom of Torna, accessible from the Dannagh Desert. The second mesa is The Great Breaksand. Palva can be found just below the northern edge of the first mesa.

Gourmand Galgan (Japanese: , Daibōshoku no Garugan) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Aspar family and can be found at level 38 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, at the Ancient Lakebed. Its Skin Upgrade art allows is to fully heal itself and level up to level 41 during the fight.
Golden Land Talismans are Talisman items in . They can be created by Haze at Campsites. The recipe for this item is received during the quest A Small Promise.
Gormotti Sashimi Plates are Seafood Pouch Items in . They can be created by Aegaeon at Campsites.
Glossy Chamomiles are Flower collectible items in . They can be found at Behemoth's Roost in the Aletta Region the Kingdom of Torna.
Golden Sand Cocoons are Key Items in . They can be found at the Streamsand Corridor. Three are needed to craft the Golden Land Talisman.
The Gideon Goldamatron is a Key Item in . It is built by Gideon during The Secret of Dannagh for the purpose of finding gold in the Dannagh Desert.
The Golden Scorpion is a Key Item in . It is a machine built by Marcus for the purpose of finding gold in the Dannagh Desert during The Secret of Dannagh.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Golden Sashes (Japanese: , Kin no Obi) are accessories in . They increase all damage dealt by up to 50% when the wearer has red recoverable HP within their team's health pool. They are the upgraded version of the Lazure Sash accessory.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Golden Greaves (Japanese: , Kin no Ashinokō) are accessories in . They increase Evasion Rate by up to 40% when the wearer has red recoverable HP within their team's health pool. They are the upgraded version of the Lazure Greaves accessory.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Golden Vambraces (Japanese: , Kin no Udewa) are accessories in . They increase Block Rate by up to 50% when the wearer has red recoverable HP within their team's health pool. They are the upgraded version of the Lazure Vambraces accessory.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Golden Headbands (Japanese: , Kin no Hachimaki) are accessories in . They increase Critical Hit Rate by up to 50% when the wearer has red recoverable HP within their team's health pool. They are the upgraded version of the Lazure Headband accessory.

|-|Normal = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Gloom Braids (Japanese: , Tokoyami no Kumihimo) are Weapon Accessories in . They can only be equipped by Lora and imbue her attacks with the Dark element. All Battle Braid weapon accessories grant Lora, Jin and Haze a Double Attack effect that give their Auto-Attacks a chance to hit the enemy twice, effectively doubling their damage and Recharge bonuses. This effect is the same as Cube-type accessories and can stack with them. The likelihood of the effect triggering is based on the rarity of the accessory. While equipped with this accessory, Lora fully resists the Doom debuff.

Gobeen Gogols (Japanese: , Gobina Gogōru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family and can be found at level 28 - 32 at Peln, Pilgrim's Springland in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Grads Tirkin (Japanese: , Guradisu Tākin) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 37-41 on the Saints' Practice Grounds of Gormott. Three must be defeated to unlock Jin's level 5 Zero Blade Blade Special. During the quest Thicker than Water, one Grads Tirkin chases Kali and Kelly towards the hole leading to the Grandarbor's Embrace, spawning at the end of the footprint tracks alongside a Keat Tirkin and a Vabra Tirkin. Fighting them is optional.

Gneo Ropl (Japanese: , Igunisu Ryibura) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 28-36 at Coolley Lake, Valafum Hill, and Nebley Wind Cave in Gormott. Two must be defeated to unlock Brighid's level 4 Twin Serpents Blade Special.
Glorr Totems are minor enemies in . They are Totems that can be found at level 39 - 41 on Verdant Fairylands in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Gio is an NPC in . He is a Tornan who can be found in the Formide Shopping Ward of Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna. He was once romantically involved with Jerry's sister, and the leader of a mercenary gang known as The Bloody Lobsters. He has since spent his life trying to make amends for his actions. He gives the quests Helping the Helper and Safety Measures, and he is involved during Making Up the Numbers. His Community is gained alongside Jerry's upon completion of What Goes Around.
Glimpse the Future (Japanese: , Bijon, Lit. "Vision") is Mythra's Talent Art in .
Golden Mug is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Hugo at Campsites.
Gibson's Location is an Info Item in . It can be bought from the Nopon Halfsage for 200,000 G, and causes the Golden Monster Herculean Gibson to spawn on Wrackham Moor in the Aletta Region.

Golden Seeker is a Key Item in . It must be crafted by using Hugo's crafting skill. It allows the party to inspect large mechanisms found throughout the Kingdom of Torna and Gormott and collect Mechanical-type collectibles.

Gloomy Aspars are quest exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family, and can be found at level 18 on the branch pathway to Saints' Practice Grounds in Gormott during the quest My First Adventure. They need not be fought to complete the quest. As with all quest exclusive enemies in , they drop no items, only gold.
Glutton's Mask is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Addam at Campsites.

The Glow Deinos (Japanese: , Tōkō no Dinosu) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Deinos family, and can be found in the Forbidden Hushland on the Bionis' Shoulder during Shoulder Survey Snaps, only at night. It will despawn upon completion of the quest but need not be defeated. The party takes a photo of it for Melekanze. As with all quest-exclusive enemies in , the Glow Deinos drops no chests.
Glutton's Herbs are three Key Items in . They are found on the Bionis' Shoulder, and are required for The Quest for Radzamalt³.
Gobble 'em Up! (Japanese: ) is Boreas's Level III Blade Special in . Gobble 'em Up! is also Boreas's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Gobble Gobble! (Japanese: ) is Boreas's Level IV Blade Special in .
Going Ballistic (Japanese: ) is Newt's Level IV Blade Special in .
Golden Font is Sheba's Level III Blade Special in . Golden Font is also Sheba's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Glow Ring (Japanese: , Gurōsākuru, Lit. "Glow Circle") is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Zephyr class. Glow Ring becomes a usable Master Art upon achieving Rank 10 with Zephyr.
Giant Swing (Japanese: , Jaiantosuingu) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Ogre class. It is a usable Master Art upon unlocking the class.

Gladiis Ekidnos are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Ekidno family, and can be found at level 37-38 and 46 on Hovering Reef 4, Hovering Reef 2, and Hovering Reef 1 of the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Glaw Camills are minor enemies in . They are members of the Camill family and can be found at level 7 near Colony 9 Front Gate in Yzana Plains and near Forward Post Camp in Alfeto Valley.
The Goods Transport Shaft (Japanese: , Busshi Unpan Shafuto) is a Location in . It is located on the third floor of Keves Castle.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Glowing Medals are Accessories in .The Gleaming Medal and Glistening Medal accessories are direct upgrades to this accessory. The common variant can be purchased from the Colony Iota Commissary.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Gold Broochs are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Clifftop Caravan. The legendary variant can be obtained from Frolicking Parker. The Platinum Brooch has a stronger version of this effect, and the Silver Brooch has a weaker version of it.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Gold Necklaces are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Lambda Commissary. The legendary variant can be obtained from Massive Georges. In , the common variant can be purchased from the Colony 9 Supply Office.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Golden Ankletss are Accessories in and .
The Gorge of Odie (Japanese: , Odi Sankyō) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Eagus Wilderness in the Fornis Region, between Bennel Cave and Nih'l Valley.

Gracious Titania (Japanese: , Enzen no Tarutaria) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 50 in the Urayan Tunnels. It can be accessed by jumping off the second section of the rope slide near the Roaring Spring. The Battle Pheromone Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Gorgeous Mandora (Japanese: , Gokusai no Morumandora) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Blant family, and can be found at level 96 in the Cavern of Oblivion in Low Maktha Wildwood. The Life Plant Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Ghosting Lulika (Japanese: , Zan'ei no Rurika) is a Unique Monster in . They are an Agnus Soldier, and can be found at level 65 in the former Colony 15 area in Erythia Sea after completing A Young Noble's Request. They form the quartet "4 Blades in the Dark" with Darkening Asha, Fleeting Shikino and Miraging Yuri. The Terran Warrior Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class for defeating them.

Ghostfist Róisín (Japanese: , Yōken no Roushin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Droid, and can be found at level 66 at the Amplifier Section in the Origin Interior. It forms the trio "Armbenders" with Cruelfist Rojou and Trickfist Tuano. The Murder Knuckle Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Glam Rock (Japanese: , Gurumu no Sekigan) is a Landmark in . It is located in Dannagh Desert of the Fornis Region. It can be reached from Klondos Table. The Unique Monster Terrorbird Zieger is found here.

Grace Row (Japanese: , Onchō no Denrō) is a Location in . It is located on the third floor of Keves Castle. It is a long hallway reached from the elevator in the Ascension Hall that leads to an elevator that goes to the Throne Room.
Gingin's Treehouse (Japanese: , Gin no Tsurīhausu) is a Location in . It is located in Low Maktha Wildwood of the Pentelas Region. It is the home of Gingin.
Giant Hornet Fossils are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Aetia Region. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They are fossilized Giant Hornets.
Glowplugs are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Battlescar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Glare Aubergines are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region or be acquired via the Fabricator at the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk. Fifty of them are required during Tau-Tirkin Alliance.
Gimme Lettuces are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Tau Caravan, or produced from the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Giant's Limbs are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be produced from the Clifftop Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Glueshrooms are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony 11 Caravan, or produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Goldleaf Cypresses are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.

Girder Potatos are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Mu Caravan and Ascension Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Golden Brog Oils are items in and . They can be dropped by Goliath Brogs in Captocorn Peak or by Begest Brogs in Low Maktha Wildwood.

Giaru Stamms are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 65-66 at Ferronis Arsenal #1, Ferronis Arsenal #3, the South Sector Passage, and the Hangar, Upper Level in the Origin Interior.
Graaf Nos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 68-69 in the Hangar Zone and Central Defense in the Origin Interior.
Graaf Zoonos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 68-69 in the Hangar Zone in the Origin Interior.
Gogol Camisiroas are Collectible items in . They are thrown by Corsaire Gogols and Envy Gogols in High Maktha Wildwood while they have a red ! over their head.
Gogol Richimoyas are Collectible items in . They are dropped by Gogols in Fornis Region while they have a red ! over their head.
Gingin is a NPC in who can be found in Low Maktha Wildwood. She is one of the seven Nopon throughout Aionios who wield an Ultimate Hammer.
Glittering Melody (Japanese: ) is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Troubadour class.
Gogol Vuagas are Collectible items in . They are thrown by Baelfael Gogols in Low Maktha Wildwood while they have a red ! over their head (alongside Gogol Olipples).
Googoo is a NPC in . Googoo is a Nopon who can be found at the Bed of Woes and Wishes in Colony Mu, Erythia Sea. Irma entrusted her with the key to her Secret Base.
The Gogols' Tree (Japanese: , Gogōru no Ki) is a Location in . It is located in the High Maktha Wildwood. The Unique Monster Immovable Gonzalez is found here.

Giaru Zestamms are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Droids, and can be found at level 66-67 at Ferronis Arsenal #1 in the Origin Interior.

Glitter Stream (Japanese: , Gurittāsutorīmu) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Incursor class. It becomes a usable Master Art upon achieving Rank 10 with the class. The user opens their sword doing a hard pierce.
Glorious Wing (Japanese: , Gurōrīuingu Lit: "Glory Wing") is a Battle Art in . It is one of Noah's Ouroboros arts.
Going Full HD is a DLC Quest in . It is accepted upon completing Champion of the Nopon.
Golden Heart is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Lapidarist class.
Glorious Feather Bands are DLC Accessories in . They can be purchased from Prize X-change Blue in the Land of Challenge for 6000 Noponstones.
Gigantic Beat (Japanese: , Gigantikkubīto) is Matthew's Talent Art in .
The Godreading Altar (Japanese: , Kamiyomi no Saidan) is a Secret Area in . It is located at the top of Oracle Spire at The Ragmos Desolation, accessible with an Ether Lift.

Gotthard-Kin Grebels are Normal Enemies in . They are members of the Grebel family and can be found at level 57-60 at the Sullied Temple of Abitalia on the Aurora Shelf when summoned by Gotthard, the Ethereal. There are four distinct versions of Gotthard-Kin Grebel used in the fight, each having different stat modifiers. The higher-leveled versions are summoned as the boss gets lower on HP.
Gooseberry Stew Recipe is a Key Item in . It allows the party to cook Meat-and-Gooseberry Stew at Rest Spots. It is obtained by talking to Carsten in Colony 9.

The Gigante Anlood (Japanese: , Giganto Haindo) is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Anlood family, and is fought at level 47 on the Old Legre-Bhaja Battlefront on the Aurora Shelf during A Melody Sustained. The Rare Anlood Guts are obtained from it after it is defeated.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Gold Jewels are Accessories in . The legendary variant can be obtained from Radicalized Godwin and Stronghammer Dorga.

Gormotti Forest is a Field Track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track fourteen on disc one from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack and disc six from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays on the Lower Level of the Gormott Province.

Glossolalia, the Allochthon (Japanese: , Ihō no Gurosoraria) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Ghost family. It can be found at level 99 in the Devil's Colony in Oblivia during and after Chapter 13 (Act 1), after the party first encounters Ghosts. Glossolalia spawns in the biggest room of the cave, but it reveals itself only when the party enters said room, descending from above.

Ghost Pilgrims are normal enemies in . They are members of the Ghost family. They can be found at level 50-54 floating near Dematerialization zones in Primordia, Noctilum, Oblivia, Sylvalum, and Cauldros during and after Chapter 13 (Act 1).

Ghost Paleriders are normal enemies in . They are members of the Ghost family. They can be found at level 54 in the Industrial District, Commercial District, and Residential District during Chapter 13 (Act 3). This enemy is not registered in the Enemy Index.

Ghost Megatherions are normal enemies in . They are members of the Ghost family. They can be found at level 55 in the Industrial District, Commercial District, and Residential District during Chapter 13 (Act 3). This enemy is not registered in the Enemy Index.

Gioramenes is an NPC in . He is an Tantalese who can be found in Zalmor's Crevice in the Kingdom of Tantal during Tender-Hearted Beast, during which he gets saved by Wulfric after getting trapped by a rockfall caused by an Enraged Gogol.
Gold, more commonly abbreviated as G, is the currency in the worlds of , , and . The party will receive gold for completing quests, and can also obtain it by selling items at Shops.
Gotsu (Japanese: , Gotsu) is an NPC in . He is a Nopon and can be found in the Whale's Nostril in Noctilum. He is Tatsu's young brother, and is met during the mission The Ties That Bind.

The Gladiator Simius (Japanese: , Guradia Shimiusu, Gladia Simius) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Simius family, and can be found at level 30 at Mesa Fortress in Oblivia during Kidnapped: Uzoma Vassago.

Grape Springs (Japanese: , Budouzenmai) are collectables in . They can be found in Agniratha and Colony 6. According to their description, they are springs shaped like grapes and nobody knows why they are shaped this way. Six are required for Agniratha Beautification 2.

Green Diodes (Japanese: , Gurīn Daiōdo) are collectables in . They can be found in the High Entia Tomb. According to their description, they are covered in moss and their light is dim, but that makes them alluring. Five are required for A Necessary Upgrade.

Green Earwigs (Japanese: , Fukamidoshijimi) are collectables in . They can be found in the High Entia Tomb. According to their description, they are coloured in rich green and their shade varies slightly by habitat.

Gravel Disks (Japanese: , Masago no Enban) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, Shulk was guessing what they were when he named them and they are not unlike a mirror of gravel.
Guardis Helms (Japanese: , Gādisu Herumu) are heavy head armour in . They were developed jointly by Colony 6 and Colony 9. They are only available from three shops.

Gravity Stone Bands are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. Interestingly, despite being considered light armour, they are by far the heaviest armour in the game, as nothing else weighs more than 5. They were most likely meant to go with the Hover Shoes, which have a similar appearance and caption. They are said to be made from the hardest substance in the Eryth Sea, Gravity Stone.
Guardis Chests are heavy torso armour in . They can be bought at the one of two shops at Colony 6, or be traded for with Anna and Earnest. They were developed jointly by Colony 6 and Colony 9.

Grady Helms (Japanese: , Guradi Herumu) are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by the High Entia using an equipment design manual from the Homs. They are only available from a single shop.
Grady Chests are heavy torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be bought at one Shop in Colony 6. They are made by the High Entia with an equipment design manual from the Homs.

Grady Arms are heavy arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by High Entia using an equipment design manual from the Homs. They are not dropped by an enemies, but can be bought from two shops.
Guardis Arms are heavy arms armour in . They were developed jointly by Colony 6 and Colony 9.
Guardis Cuisses are heavy legs armour in . They were developed jointly by Colony 6 and Colony 9. They are not dropped by any enemies, but can be bought or traded for.
Grady Greaves are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Guardis Greaves are heavy feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Grady Cuisses are heavy legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by the High Entia using an equipment design manual from the Homs. They can only be obtained from a single shop.
Graft Gauntlets are medium arms armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies.

Guard Shift (Japanese: , Gādoshifuto) is one of Reyn's supports arts in . Activating Guard Shift will cause Reyn to block all physical attacks at the cost of being unable to move or Auto-Attack while it is active, as well as reducing his evasion rate to 0%. Guard Shift can be cancelled by selecting the art again. In , Nene has an identical version of this art called Guard Sift.
H Ether Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge.
H Attack Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge.
H Ether Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge in Mechonis Field.
H Speed Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge in Mechonis Field.
H Attack Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge.
H Attack Goggles (Japanese: , H Atakku Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge.
Great Tree Bracelets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made from the roots of an ancient tree, and can only be bought at the Frontier Village Armour Shop for 9,900 G.
H Ether Goggles (Japanese: , H Ēteru Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Gust Shots (Japanese: , Gasutoshotto) are weapons in . They are rifles that can be wielded by Sharla. They can be obtained as a quest reward and they can also be acquired by trading with Suzanna who can be found in Colony 9.

Guarded Gnashers (Japanese: , Furakujō no Tsukutsuku, Unfallen Castle Gnasher) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Biters wielded by Riki, and can only be acquired from one shop in Colony 6.

Green Feris are enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at levels 83 - 85 in Satorl Marsh at night around the Barren Moor, just north of the Silent Obelisk. They can drop Lucky Fangs, one of which is required to complete Replica Monado 1. A pack of three level 79 Green Feris appears during dense fog. They patrol a route rather than staying in one spot, and will accompany Veteran Yozel if he also appears. In Future Connected, one must be defeated to complete Riddle Faifa This given by Faifa.

Greed Gogols (Japanese: , Guriddo Gogōru) are enemies in . They are members of the Gogol family, and can be found at level 75 and 77 north of Raguel Bridge and north of Raguel Lake on the cliffs and the rocky platforms on Bionis' Leg. The Greed Gogols on the rocky platforms and north of Raguel Bridge will be in a group with one Gluttony Gogol. They can drop the Gogol Horns needed for A Token of Friendship and Colony 6 Reconstruction.

Grove Quadwings are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at levels 81 and 82 in the tops of the trees at the Barren Moor in the Satorl Marsh at night. They drop Quadwing Treasures, which are needed for the Replica Monado 2 quest. They also drop a 3-slotted variant of the Meteor Nibbler, Riki's strongest weapon in terms of attack. Defeating ten of them is required to complete the quest Nic's Final Test given by Nopo'rikh in Colony 6.

Green Eluca Juice is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be dropped by Elucas in Makna Forest or traded for. According to their description, they are a spicy and bitter concoction that numbs the tongue. Two are needed for A Worried Bug-Lover.

Greedy Arachnos (Japanese: , Gōyoku no Supaido) are three quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 9 in Tephra Cave by Vilia Lake. They are sound-aggressive and appear only during the quest The Lost Pendant.
HP Steal (Japanese: , HP Kyūshū, HP Absorption) is a Gem in Xenoblade Chronicles that is grants a chance to recover HP when auto-attacking. __TOC__
H Speed Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Grizzly Drones are Mechonis Drones in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Temporal Gawain and other Mechon, but not acquired elsewhere. They are the only drones with the Speed Cowling I Appearance and missable after the events at Mechonis Core.
H Attack Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Gradies (Japanese: , Guradi) are enemies in the . They are a family of fish-like aquatic creatures, and can be blue or red. They appear identical to the Krodlaxes found in and .

Guard Entia (Japanese: , Gādi Entā) are two story exclusive enemies in . They are High Entia, and are fought in Alcamoth once, when the party is attacked in their quarters by a group of assassins of the Bionite Order.

Gust Vangs (Japanese: , Gasuto Vanpu) are enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 15 in Kisk Cave on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Vang Third Molars needed for Material Quest 4.

Guard Tirkins (Japanese: , Chekkā Tākin, Checker Tirkin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found from level 15 - 18 at the Tirkin Headquarters on Bionis' Leg. They can drop the Tirkin Crests needed for Material Quest 2.

Grom Nebulae are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 20 outside Colony 6 near Watchpoint Junction, the Splintered Path (before the events at Mechonis Core), the Freight Elevator, the Pod Depot, and the Hope Farm during rainy weather.

Guard Ignas (Japanese: , Gādi Igūna) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 28 in the Exile Fortress in Satorl Marsh. They can drop the Igna Stone Pots needed for Nopon Determination.
Grey Shells are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from Mount Tortas on Bionis' Leg.

Guardian's Wings are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. It seems to be the wing of the Satorl Guardian, and may have been intended as a drop from that boss. In the final game, they can only be obtained by overtrading with Jer'ell in Satorl Marsh after the Mechonis Core, if she has not been invited to Colony 6. According to their description, they are wings that glow when the weather is misty and the glow is just a Brocken spectre.

Grady Colour Roes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Sol Gradies. They are not available for trade. According to their description, their colour changes continuously and they are highly valued as paints.

Gun Drones I (Japanese: , Gan Furappu 1) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones surround Fiora, firing deadly beams in all directions for a six hit combo. It delivers electric damage, which can be increased by the use of Electric Plus gems. This talent art is available when Fiora has Freyja Drones, Cos-Cute Drones I, or Cos-Cute Drones II equipped. es:Pistola de Drones I

Gun Drones II (Japanese: , Gan Furappu 2) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones surround Fiora, firing deadly beams in all directions for a six hit combo. It delivers electric damage, which can be increased by the use of Electric Plus gems. This talent art is available when Fiora has Sakura, Eris or Idun Drones equipped. es:Pistola de Drones II
Grexes (Japanese: , Rupusu, lit. Lupus; English dub: ) are wolf-like enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X, primarily inhabiting Primordia and Oblivia. They are structurally similar to Caro.

Gwin Evans (Japanese: , Guin; English dub: ) is one of the eight main playable characters of . He is an Interceptor in BLADE, and was Elma and Irina's subordinate in the Unified Government Forces Special Vehicle Guidance Squad. He joined BLADE to honor his late friend Leon, and for his desire to protect Irina. Gwin is recruitable after Chapter 3.

The Grenada Galactic Group (Japanese: , Guranada GG) is a product Arms Manufacturer in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an up-and-coming Spanish arms company devoted almost entirely to beam-technology research. Its CEO is Carmela Celena. Along with Sakuraba Industries, they are among the first Arms Manufacturers in New Los Angeles. Their main products are focused on beam attributes—their beam-resistant ground gear is a best seller.
Gravity Lunge is one of Murderess's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing Serial Thriller.
Grenade Blitz is one of Gwin's two Signature Arts in . Cross learns this art after completing Boot Camp.
Hector Birtwhistle, known as H.B., is a recruitable character in . He is a young Pathfinder elite of the private military organization BLADE.
Grassland Ovis (Japanese: , Gurasu Owisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ovis family, and can be found at level 4-8 on East Gate Plain in Primordia during the day.

The Great Nail (Japanese: , Daikōgan) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, northwest of Qing Long Glade, south of Suncatch Ravine, directly beneath the Twin Hammers, and directly south of FN Site 211.

Guardian Puges (Japanese: , Gādā Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 45 at Badr Basin and FN Site 406 in Sylvalum.

Grieving Plains (Japanese: , Nageki Heigen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, southeast of Biahno Grassland and west of Sayram Lake. It is mostly inhabited by low-level grexes. A strange collection of spire-like rocks can be found in the center of the area.
HP Peril is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is activated when the party member's HP reaches 30% or lower. Regardless of customization, this Soul Voice always requests a Support Art.
HP Risk is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is activated when the party member's HP reaches 60% or lower. Regardless of customization, this Soul Voice always requests a Support Art.

Grand Evellos (Japanese: , Gurando Sutorutto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Evello family, and can be found at level 21-23 in Oblivia, north of FN Site 312 during the day.

The Greedy Forfex (Japanese: , Gurīdo Pagurusu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Forfex family and is fought at level 21 at Cliffside Beach in Primordia during the mission Nine Lives.
HP Down is a Debuff in . It temporarily reduces the target's maximum HP. Some enemies inflict this upon themselves, sacrificing some of their own health while inflicting damage upon their targets.

Grotto Mortifoles (Japanese: , Gurotto Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Mortifole family, and can be found at level 12-14 at Garden Spring (hidden) and Goblin's Narrow, or at level 19-20 at Bident Crossing and Great Trident Crossing in Noctilum.

Green Threshold (Japanese: , Midori no Dōmon) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia northwest of Biahno Lake. The path to Noctilum is situated there along with FN Site 103. Cross, Lin, and Tatsu first meet Lao here during Chapter 4. The data unit FN093 required for Primordia Trailblazing 3 can also be found at this area.
Gus (Japanese: , Gasu) is a Human in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found near the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Grassland Scirpos (Japanese: , Gurasu Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 5-8 at Roof Rock in Primordia.
Green Scirpos (Japanese: , Gurīn Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scirpo family, and can be found at level 26-30 in Primordia, near FN Site 112 or FN Site 120.

Guinea Pigs Wanted! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Alexa at the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District and the primary destination is New Los Angeles. This mission must be accepted in order to start the Affinity Mission Weaponized.

Grette (Japanese: , Gurēte) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is located at Division Drive in the Administrative District. After Chapter 6 is completed she can be found at West Ciel Sandsea in Sylvalum although it is not possible to talk to her here. She is a member of the Harriers Division.

Grinding Squirrels (Japanese: , Gurindorisu) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. They are needed for the Basic Mission Primordian Cavern Crawl. They can spawn inside the cavern cowl, at the northeast part of Primordia, and around Castaway Cavern.

Grosium Cores (Japanese: , Gurojiumu Koa) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in northwest and northern Primordia, in particular at FN Site 103, Green Threshold near the entrance to Noctilum, along the Biahno River nearby, and the Talon Rock Second Terrane. Three of them are needed for Engrossed in Grosium.

The Great Trident Crossing (Japanese: , Mitsumata Ōhashi) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a naturally trifurcated bridge structure located in Noctilum, southwest of the Ensconced Citadel. Its southern prong connects to the Bident Crossing.
Gubura Cabbage Leaves (Japanese: , Gubura Hakusai) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.

Gudo Rocamboles (Japanese: , Gudo Nobiru) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular on the east side of Sea Whisper Valley. Seven are needed for What's a Rocambole?.
HI9 Ion Thrusters (Japanese: , Ionsurasuta H19) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum. Eight are needed for Noctilum Trailblazing 2.
